summary: Tested CloudIVR web dynamic daily offers end-to-end (backend pytest 11/11 + Playwright UI at 1920 and 390) and in-app light mode. All 5 offer kinds work: number code (owner only, used once), renew 15%, upgrade 20% (quote + confirm), topup tiers (bonus paid by the 60s timer, $100 -> +$15), firstTopup (UI calc). Dismiss works and survives reload, and checkout still offers the code afterwards. The Inbox daily offer notice shows a CTA (no code) or 'Use coupon CODE'. Light mode works: follows the device, the topbar, Settings and mobile switches all work, an automated contrast/dark-panel check on 19 app pages and 13 number tabs found nothing, dark mode is unchanged and the /cloudivr landing page is not affected. Found and fixed 1 light-mode CSS bug: native <select> rendered as a solid grey block. Other issues are minor.

minor.issue: Abuse/race: the offer is only marked used AFTER a bonus is paid. If a user creates several /wallet/topup deposits before the first one confirms, every deposit carries the firstTopup snapshot and each pays up to $50. Fix: claim atomically before crediting (offers.updateOne({_id: offerId, used:false},{$set:{used:true}}) and skip if modifiedCount!==1).
A 'topup' offer is never marked used, so every top-up that day earns a tier bonus (e.g. 4 x $250 = +$200). Confirm this is intended, or cap it at one bonus per offer.

One-off transition: on the deploy day, accounts that already got the old bot-style notice (marker daily:<day>:<id> with code) get no new offer notice until tomorrow. Verified by deleting the marker: the new notice was sent within 60s.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent. In light mode every native select (Wallet Coin, Settings Default AI voice, ...) showed as a solid slate block with an unreadable value. Root cause: the light rule '.civr-input { background:#fff }' used the background shorthand, which reset background-size/position/repeat, so the chevron gradients filled the whole box. Changed it to background-color.
With a renew offer, the 'Plan' row shows the discounted price as the monthly price ('Business · $102.00/month') when only this renewal is discounted. Use the full price there.

Offer and coupon notices from past days still show 'Use coupon X' or a CTA after they expire (yesterday's NMD10LW9BB2 still shows the button). Once a CIVR offer code is used, the inbox button still appears. Hide them when expired or used.

issues: The auth pages stay dark even when the device or pref is light (the theme applies only inside the app shell), so a light-mode user sees dark login, then light app. Consider applying the theme there too.

action_items: Make firstTopup bonus payout atomic against the offer's used flag (prevents multiple first-top-up bonuses)
Decide whether 'topup' tier bonus is once per day; if so mark the offer used after the first payout
BillingTab: show the full monthly price in the 'Plan' row when a renew discount applies
Inbox: hide Use coupon / offer CTA for expired or used offers
critical_code_review_comments: offers.js payBonuses: pays the credit before marking a firstTopup offer used, so concurrent deposits are not protected
theme-light.css: avoid background shorthand overrides on elements whose base rules set background-image/size (selects); fixed for .civr-input
Verified that real DynoPay/BlockBee webhooks write transactions{type:'wallet-topup', chatId:String, metadata.ref: deposit ref}, matching the payBonuses lookup

rca of the issue: Light select bug: html[data-civr-theme=light] .civr .civr-input{background:#fff} has higher specificity than .civr select.civr-input and its shorthand resets background-position/size/repeat to defaults, so the light chevron gradients repeated over the full element. Changed it to background-color: #ffffff and verified visually on the Wallet page.
